tagline: Connecting our people's talent with opportunity
footer: You received this email because your address was used on Sanad. If it was not you, ignore it and nothing will happen.
expires: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. Do not share it with anyone.

verifyEmail.subject: Your Sanad activation code
verifyEmail.heading: Activate your account
verifyEmail.intro: Welcome to Sanad. Enter the code below on the verification page to activate your account.

passwordReset.subject: Your Sanad password reset code
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: You asked to reset your password. Enter the code below, then choose a new password.

employerApproved.subject: Your Sanad account is approved
employerApproved.heading: Hello {name}, your account is approved
employerApproved.intro: A platform admin reviewed your details and approved your account. You can post jobs now.

employerRejected.subject: About your Sanad account request
employerRejected.heading: Hello {name}
employerRejected.intro: A platform admin reviewed your request and the account was not approved.
employerRejected.contact: If you have a question, contact the platform admins.

newInterest.subject: New interest in your job: {jobTitle}
newInterest.heading: New interest request
newInterest.intro: A job seeker expressed interest in your job "{jobTitle}" and agreed to share their profile with you.

emailChangeCode.subject: Confirm your new email for Sanad
emailChangeCode.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChangeCode.intro: You asked to change your account email to this address. Enter the code below on the "My account" page to finish.

emailChanged.subject: Your Sanad account email changed
emailChanged.heading: Your account email changed
emailChanged.intro: The sign-in email of your account changed to {newEmail}. If you did not ask for this, contact the platform administration right away.

adminInvite.subject: Your Sanad admin account
adminInvite.heading: Hello {name}
adminInvite.intro: A system administrator created an admin account for you on Sanad. Sign in with the username and temporary password below; you will be asked to choose a new password right away.

noticeFooter: You received this email because you have an account on Sanad.
